title: John the Baptist sends a message and Jesus answers
description: John the Baptist sends disciples from prison to ask if Jesus is the one who was to come, and Jesus answers by pointing to his miracles: the blind see, the lame walk, lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor. Then Jesus praises John as more than a prophet and the greatest born of women, but emphasizes that the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater, and identifies John as the Elijah who was to come.
